The daemon on port %1$d requires a token. Paste it here, or restart the daemon with --no-auth. Tokens are never read from shared storage.

AtomCode needs access to shared storage so the agent can open your repositories by path — Git, shell commands and language servers cannot work with Android\'s document picker URIs. Without it the agent is limited to its private folder.
